title: Powerball Odds Got 67% Worse After the Rule Change
hook: Powerball's rule change made jackpot odds 67% worse.
closing: Bigger jackpots came with worse odds, so the spectacle costs players probability.
question: Would worse odds stop you?

segments.say: Powerball odds are one in 292,201,338. A lifetime lightning strike is dramatically more likely.
A royal flush is one in 649,740. Even that famous long shot is far easier than the jackpot.
The old odds were one in 175 million. The later rule made an already remote jackpot substantially harder.
